proves.claim: A claimed item whose gate job waits restarts the runner once for that item, and the check lists only the in-flight items.

cli.io-runner-restart.in-flight-only.why: Without it, a regression where the dead-runner check reads the whole open list again would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A board whose only claim has no gate job never starts the runner and answers null.

cli.io-runner-restart.no-gate-no-start.why: Without it, a regression where a claim with no gate job starts a runner would pass unnoticed.
